about: A local board feature has an explicit retro treatment for one new summary strip; test that the request outranks the new-UI default while the existing board stays in scope.

request.prompt: This local 8×8 board has a selection status. Add a selected-square summary strip immediately below the board; when Reset is used, return it to ‘Choose a square’. R-1: Show the selected coordinate and clear it on reset. R-2: Give only that summary strip an explicitly retro arcade/pixel-inspired appearance; keep the board, controls, and rest of the page as they are. Stay local; no dependencies or external services.

work_item.title: Add a scoped retro selected-square summary
work_item.context: Add the selected-coordinate summary below the board, returning to Choose a square on reset. Apply the user’s explicit retro arcade/pixel direction only to that strip; retain the rest of the existing board UI.

planted.what: The plan records the user's explicit retro arcade/pixel direction as the controlling choice for the selected-square summary strip, with reproducible component-level choices.
planted.signature: explicit retro/pixel direction is selected for the summary strip

planted.what: The visible-UI criterion selects the matching AD section and concrete strip anchors, and names a rendered placement check.
